plivo agent download — fetch an agent's complete flow config and write it
to a local JSON file. Same data the console UI's "Download JSON" button gives
you, in the canonical PHLO API shape (nodes, connections, phlo, global_meta).

Useful for: letting an AI agent verify its own flow configuration, checkpointing
before edits, diffing two versions, or feeding into 'plivo agent update --from
<file>'.

Defaults to writing <phlo_name>-config.json in the current directory. Use --out
to override.

Usage:
  plivo agent download <uuid> [flags]

Flags:
      --out string   output filename (default: <phlo_name>-config.json)

Global Flags:
      --all                        auto-paginate through all pages
      --dry-run                    print the HTTP request without sending
      --explain                    explain what the command will do before executing
      --hodor-server plivo agent   base URL for hodor (used by plivo agent and `plivo auth token`)
      --log-level string           log level: debug|info|warn|error|none (default "warn")
      --no-color                   disable colored output
  -o, --output string              output format: table|json (default: table for TTY, json otherwise)
      --profile string             named profile from ~/.plivo/config.toml
  -q, --quiet                      suppress non-data output
      --timeout int                request timeout in seconds (default 30)
  -y, --yes                        skip confirmation prompts
